free_tier_limits.correction: 25 requests per day on the free plan, not 50 requests per day.

rate_limits.correction: Free: 25 requests/day. Pro: unlimited daily quota with monthly quotas currently ranging from 46,000 to 420,000 requests; Enterprise supports millions-plus.

description.correction: Microlink exposes two REST endpoints: api.microlink.io for unauthenticated free requests and pro.microlink.io for authenticated requests. Both use GET requests with a target URL and parameters supporting metadata, screenshots, PDFs, and structured extraction.

notes: Current official pricing contradicts the claimed 50-request free allowance. Authentication is header-based, but current docs require the Pro endpoint; they do not document an apiKey query parameter for REST authentication. No explicit current official CORS statement was located.
